name: Electrical Plan
description: DIN 18015 installation plan, circuits, BOM, cabinet layout, KNX group addresses and inspection protocol for openPlan3D.

global.schema:
type ElectricalPlanState {
  name: String!
  activeUnitId: OID!
  units: [ElectricalUnit!]!
  circuits: [ElectricalCircuit!]!
  routes: [CableRoute!]
  distributors: [ElectricalDistributor!]!
  cabinetDevices: [CabinetDevice!]!
  groupAddresses: [GroupAddress!]!
  reports: [InspectionReport!]!
  settings: ElectricalSettings!
  nextCircuitNumber: Int!
}

type ElectricalUnit {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  level: Int!
  background: PlanBackground
  rooms: [ElectricalRoom!]
  symbols: [ElectricalSymbol!]!
}

type ElectricalRoom {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  points: [Position!]!
  fillColor: String
  labelX: Float!
  labelY: Float!
  locked: Boolean
}

type PlanBackground {
  dataUrl: String
  widthCm: Float
  heightCm: Float
  x: Float!
  y: Float!
  scale: Float!
  opacity: Float!
  rotation: Float!
  locked: Boolean!
}

type Position {
  x: Float!
  y: Float!
}

type KnxBinding {
  enabled: Boolean!
  participantName: String
  groupAddressIds: [OID!]
}

type ItemDetails {
  note: String
  price: Float
  photos: [String!]
}

type ElectricalSymbol {
  id: OID!
  defId: String!
  position: Position!
  rotation: Float!
  mountHeightCm: Float
  circuitId: OID
  roomId: String
  label: String
  color: String
  locked: Boolean
  knx: KnxBinding
  details: ItemDetails
}

type ElectricalBreaker {
  poles: Int!
  ratingA: Float!
  characteristic: String!
  rcdMa: Int
  rcbo: Boolean
}

type ElectricalCable {
  type: String!
  crossSectionMm2: Float!
  lengthM: Float
}

type ElectricalCircuit {
  id: OID!
  skNumber: Int!
  name: String!
  kind: String!
  distributorId: OID
  breaker: ElectricalBreaker!
  cable: ElectricalCable!
  phases: [String!]
  color: String
  notes: String
  installationMethod: String
  ambientTempC: Float
  groupedCircuits: Int
}

type CableRoute {
  id: OID!
  circuitId: OID!
  unitId: OID!
  points: [Position!]!
  reservePercent: Float
}

type ElectricalDistributor {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  rows: Int!
  tePerRow: Int!
  reservePercent: Float!
  location: String
}

type CabinetDevice {
  id: OID!
  distributorId: OID!
  circuitId: OID
  kind: String!
  label: String!
  teWidth: Int!
  row: Int
  startTe: Int
  phases: [String!]
  article: String
  price: Float
}

type GroupAddress {
  id: OID!
  main: Int!
  middle: Int!
  sub: Int!
  name: String!
  dpt: String!
  fixtureId: OID
  functionKey: String
  description: String
}

type InspectionReport {
  id: OID!
  circuitId: OID!
  result: String!
  rcdTripMs: Float
  rcdTestCurrentMa: Float
  insulationMohm: Float
  insulationTestVoltageV: Int
  continuityOhm: Float
  loopImpedanceOhm: Float
  rotatingField: String
  visualInspection: String
  tester: String
  testedAt: String
  nextTestDue: String
  signature: String
  notes: String
}

type ElectricalSettings {
  symbolStyle: String!
  showCircuitBadges: Boolean!
  showMountHeights: Boolean!
}

input PositionInput {
  x: Float!
  y: Float!
}

input RoomInput {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  points: [PositionInput!]!
  fillColor: String
  labelX: Float!
  labelY: Float!
  locked: Boolean
}

input ElectricalSettingsInput {
  symbolStyle: String
  showCircuitBadges: Boolean
  showMountHeights: Boolean
}

input SymbolInput {
  id: OID!
  defId: String!
  knxEnabled: Boolean
  position: PositionInput!
  rotation: Float!
  mountHeightCm: Float
  circuitId: OID
  roomId: String
  label: String
  color: String
  locked: Boolean
}

input BreakerInput {
  poles: Int!
  ratingA: Float!
  characteristic: String!
  rcdMa: Int
  rcbo: Boolean
}

input CableInput {
  type: String!
  crossSectionMm2: Float!
  lengthM: Float
}

input CircuitInput {
  id: OID!
  skNumber: Int!
  name: String!
  kind: String!
  distributorId: OID
  breaker: BreakerInput!
  cable: CableInput!
  phases: [String!]
  color: String
  notes: String
  installationMethod: String
  ambientTempC: Float
  groupedCircuits: Int
}

input CableRouteInput {
  id: OID!
  circuitId: OID!
  unitId: OID!
  points: [PositionInput!]!
  reservePercent: Float
}

input DistributorInput {
  id: OID!
  name: String!
  rows: Int!
  tePerRow: Int!
  reservePercent: Float!
  location: String
}

input CabinetDeviceInput {
  id: OID!
  distributorId: OID!
  circuitId: OID
  kind: String!
  label: String!
  teWidth: Int!
  row: Int
  startTe: Int
  phases: [String!]
  article: String
  price: Float
}

input GroupAddressInput {
  id: OID!
  main: Int!
  middle: Int!
  sub: Int!
  name: String!
  dpt: String!
  fixtureId: OID
  functionKey: String
  description: String
}

input ReportInput {
  id: OID!
  circuitId: OID!
  result: String!
  rcdTripMs: Float
  rcdTestCurrentMa: Float
  insulationMohm: Float
  insulationTestVoltageV: Int
  continuityOhm: Float
  loopImpedanceOhm: Float
  rotatingField: String
  visualInspection: String
  tester: String
  testedAt: String
  nextTestDue: String
  signature: String
  notes: String
}

input BackgroundInput {
  dataUrl: String
  widthCm: Float
  heightCm: Float
  x: Float!
  y: Float!
  scale: Float!
  opacity: Float!
  rotation: Float!
  locked: Boolean!
}

operations.name: ADD_UNIT
operations.schema: input AddUnitInput { id: OID! name: String! level: Int! }

errors.name: DuplicateIdError
errors.description: The id is already in use

operations.name: RENAME_UNIT
operations.schema: input RenameUnitInput { id: OID! name: String! }

operations.name: ADD_ROOM
operations.schema: input AddRoomInput { unitId: OID! room: RoomInput! }

errors.name: DuplicateIdError
errors.description: The id is already in use

operations.name: UPDATE_ROOM
operations.description: Rename, recolour, reshape, relabel or lock a room
operations.schema: input UpdateRoomInput { unitId: OID! id: OID! name: String fillColor: String points: [PositionInput!] labelX: Float labelY: Float locked: Boolean }

operations.name: REMOVE_ROOM
operations.description: Remove a room polygon from a floor
operations.schema: input RemoveRoomInput { unitId: OID! id: OID! }

operations.name: ADD_SYMBOL
operations.schema: input AddSymbolInput { unitId: OID! symbol: SymbolInput! }

errors.name: DuplicateIdError
errors.description: The id is already in use

operations.name: UPDATE_SYMBOL
operations.schema: input UpdateSymbolInput { unitId: OID! id: OID! defId: String circuitId: OID roomId: String label: String color: String rotation: Float mountHeightCm: Float locked: Boolean knxEnabled: Boolean }

operations.name: UPDATE_SYMBOL_DETAILS
operations.description: Edit price and note for a placed symbol
operations.schema: input UpdateSymbolDetailsInput { unitId: OID! id: OID! price: Float note: String }

operations.name: MOVE_SYMBOL
operations.schema: input MoveSymbolInput { unitId: OID! id: OID! x: Float! y: Float! }

operations.name: REMOVE_SYMBOL
operations.schema: input RemoveSymbolInput { unitId: OID! id: OID! }

operations.name: SET_PROJECT_NAME
operations.description: Change the project name stored in the document
operations.schema: input SetProjectNameInput { name: String! }

operations.name: SET_ACTIVE_UNIT
operations.schema: input SetActiveUnitInput { unitId: OID! }

operations.name: SET_UNIT_BACKGROUND
operations.description: Attach or clear the floor-plan underlay
operations.schema: input SetUnitBackgroundInput { unitId: OID! background: BackgroundInput }

operations.name: UPDATE_UNIT_BACKGROUND
operations.schema: input UpdateUnitBackgroundInput { unitId: OID! dataUrl: String widthCm: Float heightCm: Float x: Float y: Float scale: Float opacity: Float rotation: Float locked: Boolean }

operations.name: UPDATE_SETTINGS
operations.schema: input UpdateSettingsInput { settings: ElectricalSettingsInput! }

operations.name: ADD_CIRCUIT
operations.description: Add a circuit to the topology
operations.schema: input AddCircuitInput { circuit: CircuitInput! }

errors.name: DuplicateIdError
errors.description: The id is already in use

errors.name: DuplicateCircuitNumberError
errors.description: The circuit number is already in use

operations.name: UPDATE_CIRCUIT
operations.schema: input UpdateCircuitInput { id: OID! name: String kind: String distributorId: OID color: String ratingA: Float characteristic: String poles: Int rcdMa: Int rcbo: Boolean phases: [String!] cableType: String crossSectionMm2: Float lengthM: Float notes: String installationMethod: String ambientTempC: Float groupedCircuits: Int }

operations.name: REMOVE_CIRCUIT
operations.schema: input RemoveCircuitInput { id: OID! }

operations.name: ASSIGN_SYMBOL_CIRCUIT
operations.description: Attach a symbol to a circuit
operations.schema: input AssignSymbolCircuitInput { unitId: OID! symbolId: OID! circuitId: OID }

operations.name: ADD_ROUTE
operations.description: Add a cable route polyline for a circuit
operations.schema: input AddRouteInput { route: CableRouteInput! }

operations.name: UPDATE_ROUTE
operations.schema: input UpdateRouteInput { id: OID! circuitId: OID unitId: OID points: [PositionInput!] reservePercent: Float }

operations.name: REMOVE_ROUTE
operations.schema: input RemoveRouteInput { id: OID! }
operations.reducer: state.routes = (state.routes ?? []).filter((x) => x.id !== action.input.id);

operations.name: ADD_DISTRIBUTOR
operations.schema: input AddDistributorInput { distributor: DistributorInput! }

errors.name: DuplicateIdError
errors.description: The id is already in use

operations.name: UPDATE_DISTRIBUTOR
operations.schema: input UpdateDistributorInput { id: OID! name: String rows: Int tePerRow: Int reservePercent: Float location: String }

operations.name: PLAN_CABINET
operations.description: Replace the cabinet proposal for a board
operations.schema: input PlanCabinetInput { distributorId: OID! devices: [CabinetDeviceInput!]! }

operations.name: SET_GROUP_ADDRESSES
operations.schema: input SetGroupAddressesInput { addresses: [GroupAddressInput!]! }

errors.name: DuplicateGroupAddressError
errors.description: The group address is already in use

operations.name: UPDATE_REPORT
operations.schema: input UpdateReportInput { report: ReportInput! }
